title: Headache
hpi: {{patient_name}} presents with headache, nausea, dizziness, confusion, and flu-like symptoms without fever. Multiple household members affected — key clue for CO poisoning. Worse in winter months (heating systems). CO binds hemoglobin with 240x O2 affinity → tissue hypoxia. Classic: cherry-red skin (late finding). Pulse ox falsely normal. ABG: COHb >10% in nonsmokers diagnostic. Treatment: 100% O2. Hyperbaric if severe/neuro/pregnant. Identify source — faulty furnace, gas appliance, running car in garage.
